trust_decision.summary: Every CSV-derived column name must become an own data property of the parsed record object; decided at the record assembly loop in __onRecord (hasOwn for the duplicate branch, defineProperty for the write), the same path an earlier fix (#479) left open while it only null-prototyped the objname container.

landing_point.why: A reader of 'prototype replacement still reachable via columns path' goes to the `columns` mode record construction, where column names are copied into the record object.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The indexed form of objname is a separate option that cannot be combined with columns (packages/csv-parse/lib/api/normalize_options.js:452-458), and there the object key comes from a field value rather than a column header, so a solver can argue the advisory's columns-path property does not cover it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Duplicate column names must still group into arrays when group_columns_by_name is true (last-wins when false), and records must remain ordinary objects whose keys are exactly the header names; copying the earlier objname fix and returning Object.create(null) records, or skipping/renaming a __proto__ column, breaks the documented grouping and the plain-object shape the tests deep-compare.

O6_input_shapes: duplicate __proto__ header with group_columns_by_name:true (duplicate/array branch, the reported shape)
single __proto__ column with group_columns_by_name:false (plain write branch)
names supplied as a columns array or produced by a columns function, normalised through the same array
names that collide with inherited members (constructor, toString) under group_columns_by_name:true, where the old !== undefined test treated them as duplicates

O8_uncovered_routes.route: sync API with a numeric objname (e.g. 0): sync.js keeps the result container a plain array because it tests opts.objname for truthiness, so a '__proto__' value in the objname field is used as an object key - the record is silently dropped, and when cast/cast_date make that value an object the array's prototype is replaced.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: objname as an index is a separate feature that excludes columns, and the key is a field value rather than a column name, so it can be called a different concern from the advisory's columns path.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 1 file, same package: lib/sync.js vs lib/api/index.js

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the callback API's own container write Object.assign(records, {[record[0]]: record[1]})
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: sync.js:13 already contains exactly this unguarded write, so a maintainer re-implementing the callback path from the sync implementation could plausibly drop the null-prototype container.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the raw/info wrapper that merges fields into the pushed object
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the wrapper already merges option-derived keys with Object.assign, so a later change that flattened the record fields into the wrapper instead of nesting them under `record` would be a natural shape.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a per-column metadata lookup keyed by column name built during normalisation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: column objects are passed through this mapper and later looked up by name, so caching them in a name-keyed object is an easy addition.
